title: The $(\infty,\infty)$-category of spans
summary: In this paper, we construct the $(\infty,\infty)$-category $\mathsf{Span}_\infty(\mathcal{C})$ of spans, also known as correspondences, in any given $(\infty,1)$-category $\mathcal{C}$ with finite limits. This yields new models for the span $(\infty,n)$-categories for $n \in \mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty\}$. We characterize the mapping $(\infty, n-1)$-categories in these $(\infty,n)$-categories, and thereby verify that our model agrees with other models for spans.
